The '''Tunka sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] near the [[Varada sector/Legends|Varada sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region known as the [[Void of Aogros/Legends|Void of Aogros]] was located beyond the Tunka sector.<ref name="EGtW:AC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was ruled by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Poliff]].
